positions.title: Peer Learning Assistant
positions.description: As a Peer Learning Assistant I lead labs each week in which I assist students in learning basic algorithm design as well as the syntax of the language C. I hold office hours each week to give students additional help, and I grade student homework and labs to give them feedback on their work and help them improve.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: As a Software Engineer Intern at Target I was placed on the Guest Data Platform team. My team was responsible for collecting, standardizing and storing guest data. I first worked closely with a Product Owner to come up with business rules for standardizing a name and then I learned Kotlin basics and got started writing the code to standardize a name. After completing the algorithm, I wrote unit tests for the name standardizer and then met with a Data Quality team to get my code approved. The second half of the summer I worked on an Identity Resolution API that uses JanusGraph to store guest data. I refactored the Breadth First Search that was used to search the graph database for related guest payment methods and then wrote unit and Integration tests for the API to ensure that everything functioned properly.

positions.title: Information Systems Intern
positions.description: As an Information Systems Intern I was placed on a team that supports the HR division of Edward Jones and I was able to contribute to a project that stores new hire and candidate data. I wrote a Java Batch Reconciliation program that reads in a list of files and compares it to the files stored in a database. This program will run each day and if candidate data does not make it to the database an email will be sent to my team so they can correct the error and ensure that the firm is storing data in compliance with the Records Information Management Standards. Once I finished this project I wrote documentation for a new communications tool that my team was implementing at Edward Jones in order to make the transition to a different tool easier on associates and tested internal tools developed by my team to ensure they work with an upgraded operating system.

positions.title: Head Swim Coach
positions.description: As a swim coach I instructed over 80 swimmers ages 4-18 each summer and managed team communications and organization. I was promoted to Head Swim Coach in the Summer of 2017 and I trained, supervised and led weekly meetings for the other coaches to help them build leadership skills and ensure that we were constantly improving the experience for the swimmers. As Head Coach I managed swimmer data to give athletes performance feedback, and I organized and ran the team banquet as well.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: As a Software Development Intern I worked to enhance an existing web application by adding a search bar feature. I also shadowed Software Engineers and participated in design meetings to learn more about the software development lifecycle.

volunteerExperiences.description: Develop[HER] is Mizzou's first student organization dedicated to empowering women in the tech field! We volunteer with Girls Who Code and invite companies to work with our organization to help our members grow personally and professionally in an inclusive environment.
Led a group of students in organizing the logistics for the University of Missouri's Hackathon including planning the meals, venue/space, schedule and volunteer schedule.
